BiblicalUsage: Tel-melah, also spelled Tel-melach, was a place in Babylonia from which exiles returned with Zerubbabel. The children of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda came up from Tel-melah and Tel-harsha, but they could not shew their father's house, whether they were of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the men of Tel-melah came home without proof, and the record keeps their names with the rest.
